question: How many customers do we have in each region?
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region

question: What was total revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-%'

question: Which month of 2025 had the most completed orders, and how many?
sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What were our top 5 products by revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which product category has the highest return rate, measured as the share of orders containing that category that were returned?
sql: SELECT category FROM (SELECT p.category, AVG(o.status = 'returned') AS rate FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id, p.category FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id) p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 1)

question: Which region grew revenue the most from 2024 to 2025, in percent?
sql: SELECT region FROM (SELECT c.region, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date LIKE '2025-%' THEN i.quantity * i.unit_price END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date LIKE '2024-%' THEN i.quantity * i.unit_price END) AS growth FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1)

question: What is the average completed order value for business customers versus consumers?
sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) FROM (SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id) t JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: What share of orders came through the app in 2024 and in 2025?
sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 4), ROUND(100.0 * AVG(channel = 'app'), 1) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers have placed more than 10 orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)

question: How much revenue did we make during the Black Friday sale, November 24 to 30, 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'

question: Which customer spent the most in total, and how much?
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers signed up in 2025 but never placed an order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.signup_date LIKE '2025-%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)
